name: Upscale Video with Model
description: Makes a video bigger with an upscale model (Real-ESRGAN and the like), which draws in detail a plain resize cannot. The size grows by the model's own factor, 4 times for most. The frames go through the model a chunk at a time, so a long video is never held in memory and uses little disk; the frame rate, the length and the sound are kept. It is slow (about a frame a second for a 480p video on an RTX 3090) and each frame is made on its own, so fine detail can shimmer a little from frame to frame. For a plain resize use Upscale Video; to change the final size, follow it with Upscale Video at a smaller scale.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.label: Tile size
inputs.description: Pixels per side of the pieces each frame is cut in (they overlap and are blended). Smaller uses less memory and is slower; a frame no bigger than a tile is done whole. Lower it if memory runs out.
